notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). BlackRock completed the GIP acquisition on October 1, 2024, and now files under CIK 0002012383; the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000950170-25-026584) and 2025 proxy (accession 0001308179-25-000388) were filed by that entity and read on www.sec.gov. LARRY FINK: 290,327 shares plus 13,359 deferred/restricted units and options; less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null. BUYBACKS: the single cash-flow line ($1,930 million) includes about $0.3 billion of shares bought to cover employee tax withholdings; the 10-K says $1.6 billion was open-market purchases under the repurchase program. No separate withholding line exists, so the cash-flow total is used. HOLDERS: the proxy gives the filing dates of the 13G reports (Vanguard Feb 13, 2024; BlackRock Feb 9, 2024; Kuwait Investment Authority July 7, 2020) but not their as-of dates, so asOf is null; the Kuwait filing is old. GEOGRAPHY is by the legal entity that books the revenue, not customer location (Americas mainly the U.S.; Europe mainly the UK, Luxembourg and the Netherlands).

ecosystem.notes: AUM is a stock of client money, not a flow, so no take rate is computed on it. BlackRock's fee is the platform's share of client returns: the 10-K says "Investment management fees are typically earned as a percentage of AUM", and BlackRock also earns performance fees and technology services (Aladdin) revenue. The investment returns on the AUM belong to BlackRock's clients. The 10-K describes it as "$11.6 trillion of assets under management (“AUM”) at December 31, 2024".
